title: Beta-Testers for AI-Trading-Journal
author: Weird_Inspection2806
selftext:
I'm Remo, a trader from Germany. I kept making the same mistakes, so I built a journal that reads my MetaTrader 5 trades and shows which habits actually cost money: revenge trades, cutting winners early, breaking my own rules. An AI coach asks about those moments. No signals.



It's early and only works with MT5. I'm looking for about 25 beta testers, free: [https://www.traidingdesk.com](https://www.traidingdesk.com) (join the waitlist and tick beta tester). What would you want from a tool like this?

comments.author: investigatormaker
comments.body:
What I'd want first is to see the definitions. If a revenge trade means one opened within some minutes of a loss at a bigger lot size, show that rule and let me adjust it, or testers will argue with every flag. The "breaking my own rules" flag also needs the rules written down, so ask for max daily loss and trades per day at setup. Say up front whether it connects with MT5's read-only investor password; that's the first trust question here. For the 25 testers, favour people with months of MT5 history so the report has habits to find on day one.
